extraction.notes: Three-month Q1 2022 column from the FFO reconciliation (page 10). Subtotals tie: 109,880 + adjustments = 244,820 FFO; 244,820 + core adjustments = 234,176; 234,176 - 14,717 = 219,459. Share count 118,660K reproduces $2.06 / $1.97 / $1.85. Judgment calls: the non-depreciable real estate gain (-23) is classed as nareit_other since it is not depreciable real estate; the mark-to-market debt adjustment (+36, printed as interest expense item) is classed as debt_cost_amortization; COVID-19 related costs are classed as other; the debt extinguishment line is printed as a dash (0) for Q1 2022 and is included at zero. Redevelopment, revenue-enhancing, commercial and other capex lines appear below Core AFFO, so they are excluded from the AFFO total.
